executive_findings.text: D3 世界模型与预测控制当月主方向占比为 8.8%，较上月变化 +5.1 个百分点。
D6 导航与移动操作当月主方向占比为 6.8%，较上月变化 +2.5 个百分点。
D1 具身基础模型与通才策略当月主方向占比为 15.1%，较上月变化 +1.5 个百分点。

high_signal_works.summary_zh: GR-RL 通过离线数据过滤、形态对称增强与真机在线强化学习，把鞋带穿孔任务成功率从 45.7% 提升至 83.3%。
high_signal_works.title: GR-RL: A Breakthrough in Dexterous Manipulation

high_signal_works.summary_zh: RoboWheel 将单目/RGB-D 人类手物视频重建为物理可行接触轨迹，再重定向到夹爪、灵巧手和人形本体并做仿真扩增。
high_signal_works.title: RoboWheel: A Data Engine from Real-World Human Demonstrations for Cross-Embodiment Robotic Learning

high_signal_works.summary_zh: DualVLN 让 VLM 全局规划器慢速生成中程像素目标，轻量 diffusion transformer 快速输出连续轨迹，在真实动态环境实现长时序导航。
high_signal_works.title: Ground Slow, Move Fast: A Dual-System Foundation Model for Generalizable Vision-and-Language Navigation

high_signal_works.summary_zh: BiDemoSyn 从一条真实示范分解协调不变量与对象相关调整，数小时合成数千条双臂接触轨迹，并展示新平台零样本迁移。
high_signal_works.title: One-Shot Real-World Demonstration Synthesis for Scalable Bimanual Manipulation

high_signal_works.summary_zh: Motus 用 MoT 统一理解、视频生成和动作专家，并以 optical-flow latent action 支持世界模型、VLA、逆动力学等多种模式。
high_signal_works.title: Motus: A Unified Latent Action World Model

high_signal_works.summary_zh: 以互联网规模人类活动视频预训练开放视频规划器，零样本生成新场景任务的视频计划并后处理为可执行真实机器人动作。
high_signal_works.title: Large Video Planner Enables Generalizable Robot Control

high_signal_works.summary_zh: STORM 让 diffusion VLA 提议动作、视频世界模型预测结果、MCTS 搜索与重规划，在 SimplerEnv 达到 51.0% 平均成功率。
high_signal_works.title: STORM: Search-Guided Generative World Models for Robotic Manipulation
S$^2$-MLLM: Boosting Spatial Reasoning Capability of MLLMs for 3D Visual Grounding with Structural Guidance
Modality-Augmented Fine-Tuning of Foundation Robot Policies for Cross-Embodiment Manipulation on GR1 and G1
PointNet4D: A Lightweight 4D Point Cloud Video Backbone for Online and Offline Perception in Robotic Applications
NavForesee: A Unified Vision-Language World Model for Hierarchical Planning and Dual-Horizon Navigation Prediction
Dynamic Log-Gaussian Process Control Barrier Function for Safe Robotic Navigation in Dynamic Environments
